gloss: safety; well-being; whether someone is safe

definitions.gloss: safety; well-being; whether someone is safe or not
definitions.explanation: Whether a person is safe and unharmed. Composed of 安 (safe, peaceful) + 否 (or not). Most commonly used after natural disasters, accidents, or emergencies when checking on the safety of family, friends, or residents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安否|あんぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{安否|あんぴ}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: After the earthquake, I received a safety confirmation email.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{安否|あんぴ}{不明|ふめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In the disaster area, there are still many residents whose safety is unknown.

notes:
USAGE:
In earthquake-prone Japan, {安否|あんぴ}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧ (safety confirmation) is a familiar phrase. After major disasters, companies, schools, and organizations use {安否|あんぴ}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧ systems to check on employees, students, and members. Phone carriers also provide {災害用|さいがいよう}⟦{伝言|でんごん}→伝言：03448_dengon⟧⟦ダイヤル→ダイヤル：28313_daiyaru⟧ (disaster message dial) services for {安否|あんぴ} reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安否|あんぴ}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧ (safety confirmation/check)
- {安否|あんぴ}{不明|ふめい} (whereabouts/safety unknown)
- {安否|あんぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気遣|きづか}う→気遣う：13268_kizukau⟧ (to worry about someone's safety)
- {安否|あんぴ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (safety information)
- {安否|あんぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尋|たず}ねる→尋ねる：01175_tazuneru⟧ (to inquire about someone's safety)
